title.narrative: Operationalizing the MAWHIBA STEM Online Oasis in the Levant region

description.narrative: In support to the VC - Fund in Trust (FIT) - 43019513, this workplan offers the targeted students adequate STEM knowledge in different real life contemporary topics delivered through an online UNESCO e-portal, which has been designed to galvanize science and STEM education in the Arab Region. The MAWHIBA-UNESCO Online STEM Oasis offers the opportunity for students to polish their scientific knowledge and develop their creativity and interest for scientific and technical progress in a well-defined scientific approach. Students will be able to register online and receive a completion certificate once they complete the required STEM learning modules and become eligible to participate in UNESCO science fairs offered as the next phase of this project.
